name: Shenzhen Sea Star Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 1998 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, Shenzhen Sea Star Technology Co., Ltd. primarily functions within the Chinese enterprise-grade Software as a Service (SaaS) sector. The company additionally offers digital marketing services. It began operating under its current name in March 2021, having previously been known as Shen Zhen Mindata Holding Co., Ltd.
